notes: Each cover is its own Granny model. worldMatrix = model InitialPlacement * animated bone local. The bone rest is identity, so an empty curve leaves the cover on its placement. Curve knots are seconds. XML frame N is time N/30. Belt_Right plays frames 1000 to 1020 and Belt_Left plays 1020 to 1000, both at speed 2.5. gsb_0shape, gsb_11shape and gsb_12shape have no position or orientation keys in this file.
